scope: SM 12.0 compatibility, correctness, and CUDA C++ toolchain gate

host.compatibility_note: CUDA Toolkit 13.0 does not list Ubuntu 26.04 in its qualified distribution table.

historical_failure.result: Triton kernels terminated their subprocess during launch-handle initialization.
historical_failure.interpretation: Historical evidence only; the failure no longer reproduced after the driver update.

stable_environment.dependency_check: uv pip check: all 45 installed packages are compatible

gpu_correctness.coverage: Vector Add, ReLU forward/backward, Softmax, LayerNorm forward/backward, MatMul forward/backward, Attention causal/non-causal, and input rejection

isolated_nightly_environment.role: Optional diagnostic/compatibility environment. It is not required when the stable project environment passes.

default_compile.reason: Ubuntu 26.04 glibc 2.43 and CUDA 13.0 headers disagree on rsqrt/rsqrtf exception specifications.

documented_ubuntu_26_04_workaround.output: CUDA C++ smoke passed: 4097 elements on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Laptop GPU (SM 12.0)

cuda_toolkit.evidence_boundary: This proves standalone nvcc compile, driver load, launch, synchronization, copy-back, and numerical validation. It does not prove a PyTorch C++ extension ABI or the final CUDA operator benchmarks.

conclusion.default_route: Use the stable project .venv. On this machine the driver update, not the nightly Python stack, removed the Triton launch failure.
conclusion.nightly_route: Create the external cu130 environment only if the stable crash-isolated probe still fails after a driver update.
conclusion.driver_boundary: 610.88 is a tested version, not a claimed minimum for every SM 12.0 GPU.
conclusion.performance_boundary: Compatibility and correctness results are separate from the formal performance matrix.
